sourceExplanation.en: Really into something, like when you're so focused on coloring. 🎨
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常专注某事，就像你在专心画画时。🎨

definition.en: So interested in an activity that you give it all your attention.
definition.zh: 做一件事时特别投入，注意力几乎都在这件事上。

scenario.en: You keep coloring your picture and hardly notice time passing.
scenario.zh: 你专心给画涂色，连时间过去了都没注意。

expression.en: I'm completely absorbed in my drawing.
I was so focused that I forgot the time.
expression.zh: 我太专心了，都忘了时间。

expression.en: Can I finish this part first?
expression.zh: 我能先画完这一部分吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Loving to try new things, like exploring a new playground. 🌍
sourceExplanation.zh: 喜欢尝试新事物，比如探索一个新的游乐场。🌍

definition.en: Eager to explore unfamiliar places or try something new, even when it feels uncertain.
definition.zh: 很想探索新地方或尝试新鲜事，即使有点不确定。

scenario.en: You walk toward a playground you have never visited before.
scenario.zh: 你走向一个从没去过的新游乐场。

expression.en: I feel adventurous today!
I want to explore that new playground.
expression.zh: 我想探索那个新游乐场。

expression.en: Shall we try something new together?
expression.zh: 我们一起试试新鲜事物好吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Being very aware, like noticing a cat sneaking up. 🐱
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常警觉，比如注意到一只猫正在悄悄接近。🐱

definition.en: Awake and paying close attention because something may need your response.
definition.zh: 精神很清醒，留意周围可能发生的事。

scenario.en: You hear a rustle and notice a cat moving behind the bushes.
scenario.zh: 你听到沙沙声，发现一只猫正从灌木后走过。

expression.en: I feel wide awake and alert.
I heard a sound and looked around.
expression.zh: 我听到一个声音，就四处看了看。

expression.en: Did you hear that too?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling super surprised, like seeing a magic trick. 😲
sourceExplanation.zh: 感到非常惊讶，就像看到一个魔术。😲

definition.en: Very surprised by something wonderful or hard to believe.
definition.zh: 看到令人难以相信的事，感到十分惊奇。

scenario.en: A magician makes a coin seem to disappear before your eyes.
scenario.zh: 魔术师在你眼前把一枚硬币变没了。

expression.en: I'm amazed!
I can't believe what I just saw!
expression.zh: 我简直不敢相信刚才看见的！

expression.en: Come and look at this!

sourceExplanation.en: Finding something funny, like a clown doing tricks. 🤡
sourceExplanation.zh: 发现某事很有趣，像小丑表演把戏。🤡

definition.en: Feeling entertained because something seems funny to you.
definition.zh: 看到好玩的事，觉得有趣，忍不住想笑。

scenario.en: A clown makes a silly face, and you start laughing.
scenario.zh: 小丑做了个滑稽的鬼脸，你笑了起来。

expression.en: That is so funny!
The clown's silly face made me laugh.
expression.zh: 小丑的鬼脸把我逗笑了。

expression.en: Tell me another funny story!
expression.zh: 再给我讲一个好玩的故事吧！

sourceExplanation.en: Full of life and energy, like dancing happily. 💃
sourceExplanation.zh: 充满生命力和活力，就像快乐地跳舞。💃

definition.en: Showing a lot of energy and expression when you talk or move.
definition.zh: 说话或活动时特别有精神，表情和动作都很丰富。

scenario.en: You tell your friend a story, using your hands to show what happened.
scenario.zh: 你绘声绘色地给朋友讲故事，还用手比画。

expression.en: I feel full of energy!
I got so excited telling my story that I used my hands to show every part.
expression.zh: 讲到兴奋的地方，我忍不住用手比画起来。

expression.en: Come dance with me!

sourceExplanation.en: Thankful for something nice, like saying thanks for a gift. 🎁
sourceExplanation.zh: 对好事感到感激，比如对一个礼物说谢谢。🎁

definition.en: Feeling thankful because you notice someone's help or kindness.
definition.zh: 注意到别人的帮助或好意，心里很感激。

scenario.en: A friend brings you the pencil you dropped.
scenario.zh: 朋友帮你捡起掉在地上的铅笔。

expression.en: I really appreciate your help.
expression.zh: 我真的很感谢你的帮助。

expression.en: You made this easier for me.
expression.zh: 有你帮忙，这件事容易多了。

expression.en: Thank you for being so kind.

sourceExplanation.en: Very passionate, like loving your favorite game a lot. ❤️
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常有热情，像极爱你最喜欢的游戏。❤️

definition.en: Feeling strongly enthusiastic about someone, something, or a cause.
definition.zh: 对喜欢的人、事或目标抱有很强烈、持久的热情。

scenario.en: You practice your favorite song again because you love playing it.
scenario.zh: 因为特别喜欢，你又练起了那首心爱的曲子。

expression.en: I care about this a lot.
I keep practicing that song because I love it so much.
expression.zh: 因为太喜欢这首曲子，我总想再练一遍。

expression.en: May I tell you why I love it?
expression.zh: 我能告诉你我为什么喜欢它吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Really excited or stirred up, like getting ready for a party. 🎉
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常兴奋或被激起，像是为派对做准备。🎉

zh.feeling: 被激起的（需要核实具体含义）

definition.en: A word for becoming strongly stirred or alert; it has several senses that need context.
definition.zh: 表示身心受到强烈唤起的词，有不同含义，必须结合语境理解。

scenario.en: You notice your heart beating faster before a big event.
scenario.zh: 重要活动开始前，你发觉自己的心跳变快了。

expression.en: Something stirred up a big feeling in me.
expression.zh: 有件事让我心里起了很大的波澜。

expression.en: I am not sure how to name this feeling.
expression.zh: 我还不知道怎么形容这种感觉。

expression.en: Can you help me understand it?

sourceExplanation.en: Shocked by something amazing, like a surprise party. 😮
sourceExplanation.zh: 对惊人的事情感到震惊，比如一个惊喜派对。😮

definition.en: So surprised that you almost cannot believe what happened.
definition.zh: 发生了出乎意料的事，让你惊讶得几乎不敢相信。

scenario.en: You open the door and find your friends waiting with a surprise.
scenario.zh: 你打开门，发现朋友们正等着给你惊喜。

expression.en: Wow, I did not expect that!
Finding my friends waiting behind the door astonished me.
expression.zh: 看到朋友们在门后等我，我惊讶极了。

expression.en: How did you do that?

sourceExplanation.en: Very happy, like when you're eating your favorite ice cream. 🍦
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常快乐， 就像你在吃你最喜欢的冰淇淋时。🍦

definition.en: Feeling deeply happy and at ease, without wanting the moment to end.
definition.zh: 心里幸福又安宁，希望这一刻慢一点过去。

scenario.en: You sit with your family after a lovely day together.
scenario.zh: 愉快的一天结束后，你和家人舒舒服服地坐在一起。

expression.en: I feel so happy and at ease right now.
expression.zh: 我现在觉得幸福又安心。

expression.en: Sitting with my family after a lovely day feels so peaceful.
expression.zh: 美好的一天过后，和家人坐在一起真幸福。

expression.en: I wish this moment could last longer.
expression.zh: 真希望这一刻再长一点。

sourceExplanation.en: Out of breath, like after running really fast. 😓
sourceExplanation.zh: 喘不过气来，就像跑得很快之后。😓

definition.en: Breathing hard because of effort, surprise, or another physical cause.
definition.zh: 跑动或其他原因让你呼吸急促，一时喘不过气来。

scenario.en: After a fast run, you stop and catch your breath.
scenario.zh: 快跑过后，你停下来喘口气。

expression.en: I need a moment to catch my breath.
That race made me breathe so fast.
Can we slow down for a bit?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling light and happy, like floating on a balloon. 🎈
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉轻松快乐，像在气球上漂浮。🎈

definition.en: Feeling cheerful and hopeful, as if worries weigh less than before.
definition.zh: 心情轻快又有希望，觉得烦恼似乎没那么沉重了。

scenario.en: After hearing good news, you walk home with a spring in your step.
scenario.zh: 听到好消息，你轻快地走在回家的路上。

expression.en: I feel light and cheerful today.
That good news made my steps feel lighter.
expression.zh: 听到好消息，我走路都轻快了。

expression.en: I am ready for something fun!
expression.zh: 我已经准备好玩点有趣的了！

sourceExplanation.en: Very peaceful, like sitting quietly by a calm lake. 🌊
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常平和，就像静静地坐在平静的湖边。🌊

definition.en: Feeling steady and peaceful rather than worried or stirred up.
definition.zh: 心里安稳平静，没有被担心或激动搅乱。

scenario.en: You sit by the lake and listen to the water move softly.
scenario.zh: 你坐在湖边，听着轻轻的水声。

expression.en: I feel calm now.
My breathing is slow and easy.
expression.zh: 我慢慢呼吸，感觉舒服多了。

expression.en: Let's sit quietly for a moment.
expression.zh: 我们安静地坐一会儿吧。

sourceExplanation.en: Without worries, like playing all day without thinking about homework. 🏖️
sourceExplanation.zh: 没有担忧，就像整天玩耍而不想作业。🏖️

definition.en: Enjoying a moment without thinking much about troubles or duties.
definition.zh: 暂时不用为烦心事操心，轻轻松松地享受当下。

scenario.en: You play in the park with nothing urgent you need to do.
scenario.zh: 你在公园玩耍，暂时没有急着要完成的事。

expression.en: I do not have a worry right now.
Running in the park feels so free.
Let's enjoy this afternoon!
expression.zh: 我们好好享受这个下午吧！

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling happy and bright, like when the sun is shining. ☀️
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉快乐和明亮，就像太阳照耀时。☀️

definition.en: Feeling happy in a way that makes you want to smile or share your good mood.
definition.zh: 心情愉快，想笑，也愿意把好心情带给别人。

scenario.en: You wake up smiling and greet your family happily.
scenario.zh: 你笑着起床，开心地跟家人打招呼。

expression.en: I feel cheerful today!
This song makes me want to smile.
Want to sing with me?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling cozy and nice, like snuggling in a warm blanket. 🛏️
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉舒适和惬意，像在温暖的毯子里依偎。🛏️

definition.en: Feeling physically at ease or safe and relaxed in a situation.
definition.zh: 身体舒服，或在某种环境里觉得自在、安心。

scenario.en: You settle under a soft blanket on the sofa.
scenario.zh: 你窝在沙发上，盖着柔软的毯子。

expression.en: I feel comfortable here.
This soft chair feels just right.
expression.zh: 这把软椅子坐着真舒服。

expression.en: Can I stay here a little longer?
expression.zh: 我能在这里多待一会儿吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling very pleased with yourself, like when you've done something great. 😊
sourceExplanation.zh: 对自己感到非常满意，就像你做了一件了不起的事情时。😊

definition.en: Feeling so satisfied with yourself that you may stop noticing what needs work.
definition.zh: 对自己太满意，可能因此忽略还需要改进的地方。

scenario.en: After one easy win, you decide you do not need to practice again.
scenario.zh: 轻松赢了一次后，你觉得再也不用练习了。

expression.en: I thought I had done enough.
expression.zh: 我原以为自己做得够好了。

expression.en: Winning once made me think I did not need any more practice.
expression.zh: 赢过一次后，我就以为不用再练了。

expression.en: Maybe I should take another look.

sourceExplanation.en: Being calm and in control, like when you're not scared on a big slide. 🛝
sourceExplanation.zh: 保持冷静和控制，就像在大滑梯上不害怕时。🛝

definition.en: Remaining calm and able to think clearly in a difficult or exciting moment.
definition.zh: 遇到紧张或激动的事，还能保持镇定、清楚地思考。

scenario.en: You take a breath before going down a tall slide.
scenario.zh: 走上高滑梯前，你吸了一口气，让自己镇定下来。

expression.en: I am keeping calm.
I took a breath before answering.
expression.zh: 回答前我先深吸了一口气。

expression.en: I can handle this one step at a time.

sourceExplanation.en: Caring about something, like when a friend is sad and you want to help. 🤝
sourceExplanation.zh: 关心某事，像朋友伤心时你想帮助。🤝

definition.en: Showing care because you notice someone may need help.
definition.zh: 注意到别人可能需要帮助，心里惦记并想关心对方。

scenario.en: You see that your friend looks sad and ask if they need help.
scenario.zh: 你发现朋友有点难过，问问对方要不要帮忙。

expression.en: I care about how you feel.
You seem quiet today; are you okay?
expression.zh: 你今天有点安静，还好吗？

expression.en: Would you like to talk?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling sure about yourself, like knowing you can do something well. 💪
sourceExplanation.zh: 对自己感到确定，就像知道你能做好某事。💪

definition.en: Believing you can try something or handle it, even if it is not easy.
definition.zh: 相信自己有能力尝试或应对，即使事情不简单。

scenario.en: After practicing the song, you feel ready to play it for others.
scenario.zh: 认真练过那首歌后，你觉得可以弹给大家听了。

expression.en: I feel confident.
I practiced, and now I'm ready.
expression.zh: 我练习过了，现在准备好了。

expression.en: I think I can do this!

sourceExplanation.en: Happy with how things are, like feeling good after playing games. 🕹️
sourceExplanation.zh: 对现状感到快乐，就像玩游戏后感觉良好。🕹️

definition.en: Feeling satisfied with what you have or how things are right now.
definition.zh: 对眼前拥有的和正在发生的事感到满足。

scenario.en: You finish a fun afternoon and sit happily with your friends.
scenario.zh: 开心地玩了一下午，你和朋友满足地坐在一起。

expression.en: I feel contented.
I am happy with how we spent this afternoon.
expression.zh: 今天下午这样度过，我觉得很满足。

expression.en: I don't need anything else right now.

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling great and stylish, like wearing your favorite outfit. 😎
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉很棒和时髦，像穿上你最喜欢的衣服。😎

definition.en: In this context, feeling stylish or impressed with how you look; not an emotion in every use.
definition.zh: 这里指觉得自己穿着很酷；这个词在别的语境下也可能不表示情绪。

scenario.en: You put on your favorite jacket and smile at your reflection.
scenario.zh: 你穿上最喜欢的外套，对着镜子笑了笑。

expression.en: I feel pretty cool in this outfit.
expression.zh: 穿上这身衣服，我觉得自己挺酷。

expression.en: These shoes make me smile.
What do you think of my style?
expression.zh: 你觉得我这样穿怎么样？

sourceExplanation.en: Wanting to learn more, like asking questions about stars. 🌟
sourceExplanation.zh: 想要了解更多，就像询问关于星星的问题。🌟

definition.en: Wanting to find out or understand something you do not yet know.
definition.zh: 碰到不懂或新鲜的事，很想知道答案。

scenario.en: You spot an unfamiliar insect and wonder where it lives.
scenario.zh: 你看到一种没见过的昆虫，想知道它住在哪里。

expression.en: I'm curious.
I wonder where this unusual insect lives.
expression.zh: 我想知道这只没见过的昆虫住在哪里。

expression.en: Can you tell me more?

sourceExplanation.en: Amazed by bright light or a beautiful sight, like fireworks. 🎆
sourceExplanation.zh: 由明亮的光或美丽的景象惊艳，就像烟花。🎆

definition.en: So struck by a bright or impressive sight that you hardly know where to look.
definition.zh: 眼前的光亮或美景太耀眼，让你看得目不暇接。

scenario.en: You look up at fireworks lighting the night sky.
scenario.zh: 你抬头看夜空中绽放的烟花。

expression.en: Wow, the lights are so bright!
The fireworks filled the sky with sparkling colors.
expression.zh: 烟花在天空绽放出闪亮的颜色。

expression.en: Can we watch it again?

sourceExplanation.en: Really happy about something, like getting a surprise gift. 🎁
sourceExplanation.zh: 对某事感到非常高兴，就像得到一个惊喜礼物。🎁

definition.en: Feeling especially happy because something pleasing has happened.
definition.zh: 遇到特别称心的好事，感到十分高兴。

scenario.en: You open a gift and discover something you had hoped for.
scenario.zh: 你打开礼物，发现正是自己一直想要的东西。

expression.en: I'm delighted!
I opened my gift and found exactly what I had hoped for.
expression.zh: 我打开礼物，发现正是我一直期待的东西。

expression.en: Thank you for thinking of me!

sourceExplanation.en: Wanting something very much, like waiting for your birthday. 🎂
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常想要某物，就像等待你的生日。🎂

definition.en: Wanting to begin or experience something soon.
definition.zh: 很想快点开始做某件事，已经等不及了。

scenario.en: You wait at the door, ready to leave for a birthday party.
scenario.zh: 你在门口等着出发参加生日聚会。

expression.en: I'm eager to start!
I've been waiting for this all day.
Can we start now?

sourceExplanation.en: Very excited and full of energy, like when playing a fun game. 🔥
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常兴奋且充满活力，就像玩一个有趣的游戏时。🔥

definition.en: Full of lively excitement and joy that spills into your actions.
definition.zh: 兴奋又快乐，活力满满，开心得藏不住。

scenario.en: Your whole team cheers and jumps after a fun game.
scenario.zh: 一场好玩的比赛后，队友们高兴得又跳又欢呼。

expression.en: I feel full of excitement!
I have so much good news to share.
Can I tell you all about it?
expression.zh: 我能一口气讲给你听吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Extremely happy, like when you win a big prize. 🏆
sourceExplanation.zh: 极度快乐，就像赢得一大奖时。🏆

definition.en: Feeling an unusually strong burst of happiness or delight.
definition.zh: 遇到特别开心的事，高兴到了极点。

scenario.en: You hear that you have won a prize you worked hard for.
scenario.zh: 你得知自己努力争取的奖项终于拿到了。

expression.en: I am happier than I can say!
expression.zh: 我开心得不知道怎么说了！

expression.en: I can hardly believe I won that prize after all my hard work.
expression.zh: 努力这么久终于得奖，我简直不敢相信。

expression.en: Let's celebrate together!

sourceExplanation.en: Bubbly and very happy, like when you're laughing with friends. 😂
sourceExplanation.zh: 泡沫四溢且非常快乐，就像与朋友们大笑时。😂

definition.en: Cheerful and lively in a way that brightens the people around you.
definition.zh: 活泼开朗，笑意和活力让周围的人也开心起来。

scenario.en: You laugh with friends and eagerly join every game.
scenario.zh: 你和朋友笑个不停，还兴冲冲地参加每个游戏。

expression.en: I feel bubbly and cheerful!
I cannot stop laughing with my friends.
expression.zh: 和朋友在一起，我笑个不停。

expression.en: Come join the fun!

sourceExplanation.en: Really proud and happy, like after you make a great drawing. 🖼️
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常自豪和快乐，就像做了一幅很棒的画后。🖼️

definition.en: Feeling very happy and lifted up after especially good news or success.
definition.zh: 收到特别好的消息或取得成功，心里格外高兴。

scenario.en: You finish a drawing you worked on for days and cannot stop smiling.
scenario.zh: 你完成画了好几天的作品，开心得合不拢嘴。

expression.en: I feel so happy and proud!
I finished my drawing after days of work, and I cannot stop smiling.
expression.zh: 画了好几天终于完成了，我高兴得合不拢嘴。

expression.en: Can I show you what we made?
expression.zh: 我能给你看看我们的作品吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Captivated by something wonderful, like a beautiful story. 📖
sourceExplanation.zh: 被某些精彩的事物迷住，像一个美丽的故事。📖

definition.en: So drawn into something lovely that it seems almost magical.
definition.zh: 被美好的事物深深吸引，觉得像走进了魔法世界。

scenario.en: You listen closely as someone tells a magical bedtime story.
scenario.zh: 你入迷地听着一个神奇的睡前故事。

expression.en: This feels like magic.
That bedtime story made me feel as if I had entered a magical world.
expression.zh: 这个睡前故事让我觉得自己走进了魔法世界。

expression.en: Can we explore a little more?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling supported, like when someone cheers for you. 📣
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉受到支持，就像有人为你加油时。📣

definition.en: Feeling more able or willing to continue because someone supports you.
definition.zh: 得到支持或鼓励后，更有信心继续尝试。

scenario.en: A friend cheers as you try a difficult jump again.
scenario.zh: 你又试着跳过一处难关，朋友在旁边给你加油。

expression.en: I feel ready to try again.
My friend's cheering made me want to try that jump again.
expression.zh: 朋友的加油声让我想再试一次。

expression.en: Thank you for cheering me on.

sourceExplanation.en: Full of energy, like when you can't stop jumping around. ⚡
sourceExplanation.zh: 充满能量，就像你停不下来跳来跳去时。⚡

definition.en: Having plenty of energy and wanting to move or do things.
definition.zh: 精力充沛，很想活动或做事情。

scenario.en: You finish breakfast and hurry outside to play.
scenario.zh: 吃完早饭，你精神十足地跑出去玩。

expression.en: I have so much energy today!
I want to jump and run outside.
Want to play a game?

sourceExplanation.en: Totally focusedon something interesting,like a fascinating book.📘
sourceExplanation.zh: 完全专注于某个有趣的事物，像一本迷人的书。📘

definition.en: Giving nearly all your attention to something that interests you.
definition.zh: 对一件事特别入迷，注意力几乎都放在上面。

scenario.en: You read a mystery and barely notice the afternoon passing.
scenario.zh: 你读一本悬疑故事，连一个下午过去了都没察觉。

expression.en: I am really into this story.
expression.zh: 这个故事让我看入迷了。

expression.en: I was so absorbed in the mystery that I forgot the time.
expression.zh: 我看悬疑故事看入迷了，连时间都忘了。

expression.en: Can I read one more page?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling lively and excited, like when a fun song comes on. 🎵
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉活跃和兴奋，就像一首有趣的歌曲响起时。🎵

definition.en: Feeling more awake, interested, or lively after something lifts your mood.
definition.zh: 原本没什么精神，受到感染后变得活跃起来。

scenario.en: A lively song comes on, and you start tapping your feet.
scenario.zh: 一首欢快的歌响起，你不自觉地跟着打起节拍。

expression.en: That music cheered me up!
expression.zh: 那段音乐让我精神一振！

expression.en: I felt sleepy, but now I want to dance.
expression.zh: 刚才还有点困，现在我想跳舞了。

expression.en: Let's turn the music on again!

sourceExplanation.en: Very excited about doing something, like going on a trip. ✈️
sourceExplanation.zh: 对做某事感到非常兴奋，比如去旅行。✈️

definition.en: Showing strong interest and excitement about doing something.
definition.zh: 对要做的事情特别感兴趣，充满热情。

scenario.en: You eagerly pack your things for tomorrow's class trip.
scenario.zh: 你兴冲冲地收拾明天班级出游的东西。

expression.en: I cannot wait to get started!
I have so many ideas for our project.
expression.zh: 我们的作品我有好多点子。

expression.en: Can I help make it?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling thrilled, like before opening a present. 🎁
sourceExplanation.zh: 感到激动，就像打开礼物前。🎁

definition.en: Feeling lively anticipation because something interesting or important is about to happen.
definition.zh: 想到有趣或重要的事马上要发生，心里兴奋起来。

scenario.en: You hold a wrapped present and can hardly wait to open it.
scenario.zh: 你抱着包好的礼物，迫不及待想打开。

expression.en: I'm so excited!
I can hardly wait to open my gift.
Come celebrate with me!

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling very happy and excited, like after winning a game. 🎲
sourceExplanation.zh: 感到非常快乐和兴奋，就像赢得一场游戏后。🎲

definition.en: Feeling thrilled and full of energy after something exciting.
definition.zh: 经历刺激的事后，兴奋又充满活力。

scenario.en: After reaching the finish line, you throw your arms into the air.
scenario.zh: 冲过终点线，你兴奋地高举双臂。

expression.en: That was such an exciting ride!
expression.zh: 刚才的游乐设施太刺激了！

expression.en: Crossing the finish line made my heart race with joy.
expression.zh: 冲过终点线，我开心得心怦怦跳。

expression.en: Can we tell everyone about it?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling open and friendly, like making new friends at the park. 🌳
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉开放和友好，就像在公园里结交新朋友。🌳

definition.en: Feeling unusually open, talkative, and willing to connect with others.
definition.zh: 心情开朗，愿意和更多人说话、交流。

scenario.en: You greet new children at the park and invite them to play.
scenario.zh: 你在公园主动和新认识的小朋友打招呼、邀他们一起玩。

expression.en: I feel open and friendly today.
expression.zh: 今天我很想和大家交朋友。

expression.en: I enjoyed meeting the new children.
expression.zh: 认识新朋友让我很开心。

expression.en: Would you like to join us?

sourceExplanation.en: Waiting excitedly for something, like a holiday. 🎄
sourceExplanation.zh: 兴奋地等待某事，像假期。🎄

definition.en: Waiting with a feeling that something important or pleasant may happen soon.
definition.zh: 等待重要或期待的事发生，心里充满期盼。

scenario.en: You mark another day off the calendar before a holiday trip.
scenario.zh: 假期旅行快到了，你又在日历上划掉一天。

expression.en: I am looking forward to tomorrow.
I keep wondering what the trip will be like.
expression.zh: 我一直在想旅行会是什么样。

expression.en: What are you looking forward to?

sourceExplanation.en: Very joyful, like when your team wins a match. 🏅
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常快乐，就像你的队伍赢得比赛时。🏅

definition.en: Feeling triumphant and full of joy after a success.
definition.zh: 取得成功后，心里充满欢欣和自豪。

scenario.en: Your team wins the final match and everyone celebrates together.
scenario.zh: 队伍赢下最后一场比赛，大家高兴地庆祝。

expression.en: We did it!
Our team scored the winning point.
expression.zh: 我们队拿到了制胜的一分。

expression.en: Come cheer with us!

sourceExplanation.en: Very interested in something, like watching bugs in the garden. 🐞
sourceExplanation.zh: 对某事非常感兴趣，像观察花园里的虫子。🐞

definition.en: So interested in something that you want to keep looking or learning.
definition.zh: 对某件事着迷，还想一直观察或了解下去。

scenario.en: You watch tiny bugs carry leaves across the garden.
scenario.zh: 你盯着花园里的小虫子搬树叶，看了好久。

expression.en: I'm fascinated by these bugs.
expression.zh: 这些小虫子太让我着迷了。

expression.en: I could watch them all afternoon.
Would you like to look with me?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling no worries, like running fast in an open field. 🌾
sourceExplanation.zh: 没有担忧，就像在开阔的田野里快跑。🌾

definition.en: Feeling able to choose or move without something holding you back.
definition.zh: 不再被限制或束缚，能自在地选择和行动。

scenario.en: You run across a wide field with room to move in any direction.
scenario.zh: 你在开阔的草地上奔跑，想往哪儿跑都可以。

expression.en: I feel free!
There's so much space to run.
expression.zh: 这里有好大一片地方可以跑。

expression.en: Come run with me!

sourceExplanation.en: Being nice to others, like sharing your toys. 🧸
sourceExplanation.zh: 对他人友好，就像分享你的玩具。🧸

definition.en: Treating people kindly and showing that you welcome their company.
definition.zh: 对别人友善，让人感到受欢迎、容易亲近。

scenario.en: You invite a child who is new to your class to join a game.
scenario.zh: 你邀请刚转来班里的同学一起玩游戏。

expression.en: I want to be friendly.
I invited our new classmate to play with us.
expression.zh: 我邀请新来的同学和我们一起玩。

expression.en: Would you like to play with us?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling very happy with what you've done, like after building a big tower. 🏢
sourceExplanation.zh: 对你所做的感到非常满足，像建造了一个大塔后。🏢

definition.en: Feeling that something important to you has been done in a satisfying way.
definition.zh: 完成自己在乎的事情后，感到充实而满足。

scenario.en: You look at the block tower you worked so hard to finish.
scenario.zh: 你看着费了不少心思终于搭好的积木塔。

expression.en: I feel satisfied with what I made.
expression.zh: 我对自己的作品很满足。

expression.en: I worked hard on this tower, and now it is finally finished.
expression.zh: 我费了好大劲，终于把积木塔搭好了。

expression.en: May I show it to you?

sourceExplanation.en: Happy about something, like when someone says thank you. 💌
sourceExplanation.zh: 对某事感到高兴，就像有人说谢谢你时。💌

definition.en: Feeling happy or relieved about something that happened.
definition.zh: 因发生了好事或担心的事解决了而感到高兴。

scenario.en: Someone thanks you for helping, and you feel glad you did.
scenario.zh: 有人感谢你的帮助，你也很高兴自己帮上了忙。

expression.en: I am glad you are here.
When someone thanked me, I was glad I could help.
expression.zh: 有人向我道谢时，我很高兴自己帮上忙。

expression.en: Shall we do something fun together?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling really happy and a bit naughty, like playing a fun prank. 😜
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉真的很快乐且有点顽皮，像玩一个有趣的恶作剧。😜

definition.en: Showing lively delight, sometimes with a playful mischievous streak.
definition.zh: 开心得眉飞色舞，有时还带着一点调皮劲儿。

scenario.en: You grin as your friend opens a funny surprise you prepared.
scenario.zh: 朋友打开你准备的搞笑惊喜，你乐得咧开嘴。

expression.en: I cannot stop giggling!
That silly game is so much fun.
expression.zh: 那个搞笑的游戏真好玩。

expression.en: Want to play another round?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling proud and wonderful, like when you finish a difficult task. 🌟
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉自豪和精彩，就像你完成一项困难任务时。🌟

definition.en: Describing something wonderful or splendid, rather than a precise feeling.
definition.zh: 形容事物非常美好或精彩，本身不是一种明确的情绪。

scenario.en: You stand on a hill and admire a brilliant sunrise.
scenario.zh: 你站在小山上，欣赏壮丽的日出。

expression.en: What a glorious sunrise!
The whole sky turned gold as the sun came up.
expression.zh: 太阳升起时，天空都染上了金色。

expression.en: Can we remember this day?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling bright and happy, like when you feel proud of yourself. 🌟
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉明亮和快乐，就像你为自己感到自豪时。🌟

definition.en: Looking bright and happy because you feel pleased or proud.
definition.zh: 因为高兴或自豪，脸上透着喜悦。

scenario.en: You smile proudly when your family sees your finished painting.
scenario.zh: 家人看到你完成的画作，你脸上露出自豪的笑。

expression.en: I am beaming with happiness!
expression.zh: 我高兴得脸上都发光了！

expression.en: When my family saw my painting, I could not stop smiling.
expression.zh: 家人看到我的画，我开心得一直笑。

expression.en: Can I tell you why?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling cheerful and funny, like telling jokes with friends. 😂
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉快乐和有趣，像与朋友讲笑话。😂

definition.en: Usually cheerful and able to laugh kindly, even when little things go wrong.
definition.zh: 平时心情开朗，遇到小麻烦也能友善地笑一笑。

scenario.en: When your hat blows off, you laugh and chase after it.
scenario.zh: 帽子被风吹跑了，你笑着追过去。

expression.en: I am in a cheerful mood.
I can laugh at my own silly mistake.
expression.zh: 我连自己闹的小笑话都能笑出来。

expression.en: Want to hear a joke?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling thankful for something good, like a nice day or a helpful friend. 🌞
sourceExplanation.zh: 为某些好事感到感激，像美好的一天或一个乐于助人的朋友。🌞

definition.en: Feeling thankful because someone has helped or cared for you.
definition.zh: 别人帮助或关心了你，你心里很感谢。

scenario.en: Your friend helps you carry your bag when your hands are full.
scenario.zh: 你的双手拿满了东西，朋友帮你提起书包。

expression.en: I feel grateful.
Thank you for helping me today.
Your kindness means a lot to me.

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling pleased and satisfied, like when a plan goes just right. 👍
sourceExplanation.zh: 感到高兴和满足，就像计划进行得很顺利时。👍

definition.en: Feeling pleased because a hope or effort turned out well.
definition.zh: 自己的努力有了好结果，心里感到欣慰和满足。

scenario.en: Your group plan works and everyone enjoys the activity.
scenario.zh: 小组精心准备的活动顺利完成，大家玩得很开心。

expression.en: I am happy with how it turned out.
Our carefully planned activity went just as we hoped.
expression.zh: 认真准备的活动和期待的一样顺利。

expression.en: Let's thank everyone who helped.

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling joyful, like when you're playing your favorite game. 😀
sourceExplanation.zh: 感到快乐，就像你在玩你最喜欢的游戏时。😀

definition.en: Feeling good and pleased about life or something happening right now.
definition.zh: 对现在的事或生活感到快乐，心里舒畅。

scenario.en: You play a game you love with a good friend.
scenario.zh: 你和好朋友一起玩最喜欢的游戏。

expression.en: I feel happy!
Playing this game makes me smile.
expression.zh: 玩这个游戏让我笑个不停。

expression.en: Come play with me!

sourceExplanation.en: Being useful and kind, like helping someone carry something heavy. 💪
sourceExplanation.zh: 有用且友好，就像帮助某人搬重物时。💪

definition.en: Choosing to do something useful or kind for another person.
definition.zh: 主动做对别人有用的事，是一种行为而不是情绪。

scenario.en: You help a younger child carry their heavy books.
scenario.zh: 你帮一个小朋友搬起沉沉的书。

expression.en: I would like to help.
I can carry some of those books.
What can I do to help you?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling like something good will happen, like waiting for a surprise. 🌈
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉会发生好事，像等待一个惊喜。🌈

definition.en: Believing that something good may happen, even if you do not know for sure.
definition.zh: 虽然还不确定，但相信事情有希望向好的方向发展。

scenario.en: You plant seeds and look forward to seeing the first shoots.
scenario.zh: 你种下种子，期待它们冒出第一颗嫩芽。

expression.en: I feel hopeful.
I hope the seeds I planted will sprout soon.
expression.zh: 真希望我种的种子快点发芽。

expression.en: Shall we try again tomorrow?
expression.zh: 我们明天再试一次好吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Wanting to know about everything, like asking lots of questions. 🤔
sourceExplanation.zh: 想了解一切，像提很多问题。🤔

definition.en: Often wanting to ask questions and learn how things work.
definition.zh: 经常爱提问，想弄明白事情是怎么回事。

scenario.en: You keep asking your teacher how the stars shine.
scenario.zh: 你不停地问老师星星为什么会发光。

expression.en: I have so many questions!
I keep wondering why the stars shine.
expression.zh: 我一直想知道星星为什么会发光。

expression.en: Could we look it up together?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling creative and excited to make something new. 🎨
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉有创造力且兴奋地制作新东西。🎨

definition.en: Feeling a new idea or strong wish to create or try something.
definition.zh: 受到触动，脑海里冒出新点子，很想动手试一试。

scenario.en: A beautiful painting gives you an idea for your own drawing.
scenario.zh: 看到一幅漂亮的画，你也有了自己的绘画点子。

expression.en: I feel inspired!
I have an idea for a new drawing.
Can I show you what I imagined?
expression.zh: 我能给你看看我的想法吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling very strong emotions, like really loving a movie. 🎥
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉非常强烈的情绪，就像非常喜欢一部电影。🎥

definition.en: Describing a feeling that seems especially powerful, not a particular emotion by itself.
definition.zh: 形容某种感受特别强烈，本身不是一种具体情绪。

scenario.en: A moving movie leaves you full of powerful feelings.
scenario.zh: 一部感人的电影让你心里涌起很强烈的感受。

expression.en: I feel something very strongly.
expression.zh: 我现在有一种很强烈的感觉。

expression.en: That story stayed in my mind all day.
expression.zh: 那个故事让我一整天都忘不掉。

expression.en: Could I tell you what moved me?
expression.zh: 我能讲讲它为什么打动我吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Wanting to learn more about something, like dinosaurs or planets. 🦕
sourceExplanation.zh: 想要了解更多关于某事的信息，像恐龙或行星。🦕

definition.en: Wanting to pay attention to or learn more about something.
definition.zh: 对某件事感兴趣，想多看看、多了解。

scenario.en: You lean closer to a dinosaur exhibit to read more about it.
scenario.zh: 在恐龙展柜前，你凑近看介绍，想知道更多。

expression.en: I'm interested in this.
I want to learn more about dinosaurs.
Could we read a book about it?
expression.zh: 我们能找本相关的书看看吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Very interested in something, like a mystery story. 🕵️
sourceExplanation.zh: 对某事非常感兴趣，像一个神秘的故事。🕵️

definition.en: Interested because something unusual makes you want to know more.
definition.zh: 遇到有点神秘或特别的事，被勾起了好奇心。

scenario.en: You read the first page of a mystery and wonder what happens next.
scenario.zh: 你读了悬疑故事的第一页，好奇接下来会怎样。

expression.en: That is interesting and mysterious.
I want to know what happens next.
expression.zh: 我真想知道接下来会怎样。

expression.en: Can we keep reading?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling energetic and refreshed, like after a good sleep. 😊
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉精力充沛且焕然一新，就像睡了一个好觉后。😊

definition.en: Feeling fresh and full of energy after rest or activity.
definition.zh: 休息或活动过后，精神恢复了，感觉充满活力。

scenario.en: After a good night's sleep, you get up ready to play.
scenario.zh: 美美睡了一夜后，你精神十足地起床准备玩耍。

expression.en: I feel fresh and full of energy!
A good night's sleep helped me feel better.
Want to go for a walk?

sourceExplanation.en: Taking part in something, like a game or a project. 🎨
sourceExplanation.zh: 参与某事，像游戏或项目。🎨

definition.en: Taking part in an activity and paying attention to what the group is doing.
definition.zh: 正在参与一件事，并关心事情怎样进展。

scenario.en: You help friends paint the backdrop for a class play.
scenario.zh: 你和朋友一起为班级演出画背景。

expression.en: I want to be part of this.
I am helping paint the backdrop for our class play.
expression.zh: 我正在为班级演出画背景。

expression.en: Is there a job I can help with?
expression.zh: 有没有我能帮忙的地方？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling really happy, like on your birthday. 🎂
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉真的很快乐，就像在你的生日。🎂

definition.en: Feeling full of happiness, especially on a special or meaningful occasion.
definition.zh: 内心充满快乐，尤其是在有意义的好日子里。

scenario.en: At a birthday meal, you laugh with people you love.
scenario.zh: 生日聚餐时，你和喜欢的人一起开心地笑。

expression.en: This is such a joyful day!
Being with my family on my birthday makes me so happy.
expression.zh: 生日这天和家人在一起，我开心极了。

expression.en: Let's make another happy memory!
expression.zh: 我们再一起创造开心的回忆吧！

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling very happy, like cheering at a fun event. 🥳
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉非常快乐，像在有趣的活动中欢呼。🥳

definition.en: Feeling so delighted by success or news that you want to cheer.
definition.zh: 成功或听到喜讯后，高兴得想欢呼。

scenario.en: Your team wins the final game and everyone shouts with joy.
scenario.zh: 球队赢下决赛，大家高兴得欢呼起来。

expression.en: Hooray, we made it!
Everyone cheered when the game ended.
expression.zh: 比赛结束时大家都欢呼起来。

expression.en: High five!

sourceExplanation.en: Excited and ready for something, like before a race. 🏁
sourceExplanation.zh: 兴奋且准备好某事，像赛跑前。🏁

definition.en: Feeling unusually tense and ready for action, sometimes excited and sometimes worried.
definition.zh: 兴奋或紧张得绷紧了神经，随时准备行动。

scenario.en: Before the race starts, you bounce on your toes and wait.
scenario.zh: 比赛快开始了，你踮着脚在起点等待。

expression.en: I feel excited and a little jumpy.
The race is about to start.
Can we take one deep breath first?
expression.zh: 我们先深呼吸一下好吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling love towards someone or something, like your pet. 🐶
sourceExplanation.zh: 对某人或某物感觉有爱，像你的宠物。🐶

definition.en: Showing warm care and affection through words or actions.
definition.zh: 用言语或行动表达对人或动物的爱与关心。

scenario.en: You gently stroke your pet after it comes over to you.
scenario.zh: 小宠物主动靠过来，你温柔地摸摸它。

expression.en: I feel so much love for my family.
I like sitting close to them.
Can I give you a hug?

sourceExplanation.en: Soft and gentle, like a warm, sunny afternoon. 🌄
sourceExplanation.zh: 柔和且温柔，像一个温暖、阳光明媚的下午。🌄

definition.en: Feeling gently relaxed, without much excitement or worry.
definition.zh: 心情柔和、放松，没有强烈的兴奋或担心。

scenario.en: You rest by a window in the quiet afternoon light.
scenario.zh: 午后的阳光洒进来，你安静地靠窗休息。

expression.en: I feel peaceful and gentle today.
expression.zh: 今天我心里很柔和、平静。

expression.en: The warm afternoon makes me sleepy.
expression.zh: 暖暖的下午让我有点想睡。

expression.en: Shall we listen to some quiet music?
expression.zh: 我们听点轻柔的音乐好吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Happy and cheerful, like during a party. 🎉
sourceExplanation.zh: 快乐和欢快，像在派对期间。🎉

definition.en: Feeling cheerful and ready to laugh or celebrate.
definition.zh: 心情愉快，想笑，也乐意和别人一起庆祝。

scenario.en: You sing with your family while decorating for a holiday.
scenario.zh: 准备节日装饰时，你和家人边忙边唱歌。

expression.en: I am in a happy, festive mood!
expression.zh: 我今天很有节日的好心情！

expression.en: The party music makes me smile.
expression.zh: 派对音乐让我笑开了花。

expression.en: Come celebrate with us!

sourceExplanation.en: Full of laughter and happiness, like joking with friends. 😄
sourceExplanation.zh: 充满笑声和快乐，像与朋友开玩笑。😄

definition.en: Full of warm laughter and genuine amusement.
definition.zh: 开心地笑个不停，觉得事情特别有趣。

scenario.en: Your friends tell a funny story and you all laugh together.
scenario.zh: 朋友讲了个有趣的故事，大家笑成一团。

expression.en: I am full of laughter today!
My friend just told a silly joke.
expression.zh: 朋友刚讲了个好笑的笑话。

expression.en: Tell me another one!

sourceExplanation.en: Touched emotionally, like by a sweet story. 😢
sourceExplanation.zh: 情感上被感动，像被一个甜蜜的故事感动。😢

definition.en: Feeling deeply touched by something kind, beautiful or meaningful.
definition.zh: 看到善意、美好或有意义的事，心里深受触动。

scenario.en: You hear how a friend quietly helped someone in need.
scenario.zh: 你听说朋友悄悄帮助了有困难的人，心里很感动。

expression.en: That story really touched me.
expression.zh: 那个故事真的让我感动。

expression.en: Hearing how my friend helped someone brought tears to my eyes.
expression.zh: 听到朋友帮助别人的事，我眼眶都湿了。

expression.en: Can I tell you which part I loved?
expression.zh: 我能说说最喜欢哪一段吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Believing that good things will happen, like hoping for sunny weather. 🌞
sourceExplanation.zh: 相信会发生好事，像希望天气晴朗。🌞

definition.en: Usually expecting that things can go well, even when you are unsure.
definition.zh: 即使不确定结果，也倾向于相信事情能向好的方向发展。

scenario.en: You see clouds before the picnic and say the weather may improve.
scenario.zh: 野餐前看到乌云，你仍觉得天气可能会转好。

expression.en: I think things can get better.
expression.zh: 我相信事情会慢慢好起来。

expression.en: The clouds look dark, but the sun might still come out.
expression.zh: 虽然乌云很多，太阳也许还是会出来。

expression.en: Shall we try again together?

sourceExplanation.en: Extremely happy, like when you get the best gift ever. 🎁
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常快乐，就像你得到有史以来最好的礼物。🎁

definition.en: Feeling an exceptionally strong happiness about something wonderful.
definition.zh: 遇到特别好的事，开心得不得了。

scenario.en: You open a letter with wonderful news and jump for joy.
scenario.zh: 你打开一封带来好消息的信，高兴得跳起来。

expression.en: I am so happy I could jump!
I got the news I was waiting for.
expression.zh: 我等了好久的好消息终于来了。

expression.en: Come celebrate with me!

sourceExplanation.en: Having lots of strong feelings, like when everyone sings happy birthday. 🎈
sourceExplanation.zh: 有很多强烈的情绪，就像每个人唱生日快乐时。🎈

definition.en: Feeling too many strong, even happy, emotions at once to take them all in easily.
definition.zh: 一下子涌来太多强烈的感受，即使是开心，也有点不知所措。

scenario.en: Everyone sings to surprise you, and you pause, not sure what to say.
scenario.zh: 大家突然唱歌给你惊喜，你愣了一下，不知说什么好。

expression.en: I have so many happy feelings at once!
expression.zh: 我一下子涌上好多开心的感觉！

expression.en: Everyone surprised me on my birthday.
expression.zh: 大家在我生日这天给了我惊喜。

expression.en: I need a moment to take it all in.
expression.zh: 让我缓一缓，好好感受这一切。

sourceExplanation.en: Quiet and calm, like early morning when no one else is awake. 🌅
sourceExplanation.zh: 安静和平静，像早晨没有其他人醒来时。🌅

definition.en: Feeling quiet and safe inside, without much worry or conflict.
definition.zh: 内心安宁，没什么担心或纷扰。

scenario.en: You listen to birds early in the morning before the day gets busy.
scenario.zh: 一大早，你听着鸟叫，静静享受还没忙起来的清晨。

expression.en: I feel peaceful.
The house is quiet early in the morning.
Can we enjoy this quiet for a while?
expression.zh: 我们能安静地待一会儿吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Cheerful and lively, like when you're excited about a new day. ☀️
sourceExplanation.zh: 快乐和活泼，就像你对新的一天感到兴奋时。☀️

definition.en: Looking or feeling lively, cheerful and ready to go.
definition.zh: 精神活泼，心情轻快，准备迎接新的一天。

scenario.en: You hop out of bed and happily greet everyone.
scenario.zh: 你一跃下床，兴冲冲地和大家问好。

expression.en: I feel bright and lively!
I jumped out of bed ready to play.
expression.zh: 我一早起来就想出去玩。

expression.en: Shall we go outside?

sourceExplanation.en: Nice and enjoyable, like a gentle breeze on a warm day. 🍃
sourceExplanation.zh: 好的和令人愉快，像温暖的一天里的轻风。🍃

definition.en: Describing an experience that feels nice or enjoyable, rather than one precise emotion.
definition.zh: 形容一件事让人觉得舒服或愉快，并不指某一种具体情绪。

scenario.en: A gentle breeze cools you while you sit in the shade.
scenario.zh: 你坐在树荫下，一阵微风吹来，舒服极了。

expression.en: This feels nice.
The cool breeze feels wonderful in the shade.
expression.zh: 树荫下的凉风吹着真舒服。

expression.en: Want to sit here for a while?

sourceExplanation.en: Happy about something, like getting a good grade on a test. 👍
sourceExplanation.zh: 对某事感到高兴，比如在测试中得到好成绩。👍

definition.en: Feeling quietly happy because something meets your hope or expectation.
definition.zh: 事情符合期待时，心里觉得满意又高兴。

scenario.en: You see a good result on a test you prepared for.
scenario.zh: 你看到认真准备的测验取得了不错的成绩。

expression.en: I am pleased with my work.
expression.zh: 我对自己的作品很满意。

expression.en: I tried hard, and it turned out well.
Can I show you what I did?
expression.zh: 我能给你看看我做的吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling really good about something you've done, like a hard project. 🏆
sourceExplanation.zh: 对你所做的感到非常好，像一个困难的项目。🏆

definition.en: Feeling good about effort, progress, or something important to you.
definition.zh: 因为自己的努力、进步或在乎的事而感到自豪。

scenario.en: After many tries, you finish your difficult model.
scenario.zh: 试了很多次以后，你终于做好了那件很难的模型。

expression.en: I feel proud of myself!
I finished that hard project.
expression.zh: 我完成了那个很难的作品。

expression.en: Can I show you what I made?
expression.zh: 我能给你看看我的作品吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Not noisy, like whispering instead of shouting. 🤫
sourceExplanation.zh: 不吵闹，像低声说话而不是大喊。🤫

definition.en: Making little sound or speaking softly, not necessarily feeling any particular way.
definition.zh: 声音很轻或不爱说话，不一定代表某种心情。

scenario.en: You whisper to your friend while others are reading.
scenario.zh: 别人正在阅读时，你轻声和朋友说话。

expression.en: I want a little quiet time.
Reading by myself feels peaceful.
Could we turn the volume down?

sourceExplanation.en: Shining brightly, like when you're really happy. ✨
sourceExplanation.zh: 明亮地闪耀，就像你真的很快乐时。✨

definition.en: Looking full of happiness or warmth that other people can notice.
definition.zh: 开心或温暖的心情仿佛都写在脸上。

scenario.en: You smile brightly as you show your drawing to your family.
scenario.zh: 你把画拿给家人看，脸上露出灿烂的笑。

expression.en: I feel so happy inside!
I cannot stop smiling after that surprise.
expression.zh: 那个惊喜让我笑个不停。

expression.en: May I tell you the good news?
expression.zh: 我能告诉你那个好消息吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling extreme happiness, like when you can't stop smiling. 😃
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉极度快乐，就像你停不下来微笑时。😃

definition.en: Feeling a very powerful delight that is difficult to contain.
definition.zh: 因为特别令人高兴的事，欣喜得难以抑制。

scenario.en: The audience cheers when the band plays everyone's favorite song.
scenario.zh: 乐队演奏大家最爱的歌时，观众兴奋地欢呼。

expression.en: I am over the moon!
When the band played our favorite song, everyone cheered.
expression.zh: 乐队演奏最爱的歌时，我们都激动地欢呼起来。

expression.en: Come celebrate with us!
expression.zh: 快来和我们一起庆祝吧！

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling fresh and lively, like after a good night's sleep. 😌
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉清新和活泼，就像经过一个良好的夜晚睡眠后。😌

definition.en: Feeling rested and more energetic after sleep or a break.
definition.zh: 睡觉或休息之后恢复精神，感觉神清气爽。

scenario.en: After a nap, you wake up ready to do more.
scenario.zh: 小睡一会儿醒来，你又有精神继续活动了。

expression.en: I feel refreshed after resting.
That nap helped me get my energy back.
expression.zh: 睡了一小觉，我又有力气了。

expression.en: I am ready to play again!

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling calm and not stressed, like lying in a hammock. 😌
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉平静且没有压力，就像躺在吊床上。😌

definition.en: Feeling at ease, with little tension in your body or mind.
definition.zh: 身心松弛自在，没有紧绷着的感觉。

scenario.en: You lie comfortably in a hammock after playing.
scenario.zh: 玩累了，你舒服地躺在吊床上。

expression.en: I feel relaxed.
It's nice to rest after playing.
Let's sit quietly for a while.
expression.zh: 我们安静地坐一会儿吧。

sourceExplanation.en: Happy with how things turned out, like after a good meal. 😋
sourceExplanation.zh: 对事情的结果感到高兴，就像吃了一顿好饭后。😋

definition.en: Feeling that something is good enough or has turned out as you wanted.
definition.zh: 觉得结果合心意，已经很满意。

scenario.en: You finish making lunch and enjoy what you prepared.
scenario.zh: 你做完午餐，吃着自己准备的东西，觉得很满意。

expression.en: I feel satisfied.
I cooked my lunch, and I am happy with how it turned out.
expression.zh: 午餐是我自己做的，我对成果很满意。

expression.en: I am happy with how things turned out.

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling safe and protected, like being at home with your family. 🏡
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉安全和受保护，就像与家人在家里一样。🏡

definition.en: Feeling safe and trusting that you are protected or cared for.
definition.zh: 觉得自己安全、受到照顾，心里很踏实。

scenario.en: You sit beside a trusted adult during a storm.
scenario.zh: 打雷的时候，你坐在信任的大人身旁，觉得很安心。

expression.en: I feel safe here.
Sitting beside someone I trust helps me feel safe.
expression.zh: 坐在信任的大人身旁，我觉得很安心。

expression.en: Can we stay together a little longer?
expression.zh: 我们能再一起待一会儿吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Easily feeling things, like when a movie makes you cry. 😢
sourceExplanation.zh: 容易感觉到事物，就像一部电影让你哭泣时。😢

definition.en: Easily noticing or being affected by feelings, sights, sounds or other experiences.
definition.zh: 对感受或周围的变化比较敏感，容易受到触动。

scenario.en: A moving story brings tears to your eyes.
scenario.zh: 听到一个感人的故事，你眼眶有点湿润。

expression.en: That story moved me deeply.
I felt tears in my eyes at the ending.
expression.zh: 看到结尾我眼眶都湿了。

expression.en: Can I tell you why it mattered to me?
expression.zh: 我能说说它为什么打动我吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Very calm and peaceful, like watching a beautiful sunset. 🌄
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常平静和宁静，就像观看一个美丽的日落。🌄

definition.en: Feeling deeply calm and undisturbed.
definition.zh: 心情格外平和宁静，不容易被小事打扰。

scenario.en: You watch the sun set over a still lake.
scenario.zh: 你看着太阳缓缓落到平静的湖面那边。

expression.en: I feel peaceful and still.
Watching the sunset makes me slow down.
expression.zh: 看日落让我慢慢放松下来。

expression.en: Can we watch quietly together?
expression.zh: 我们一起安静地看好吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Amazed and captivated, like watching a magician. 🎩
sourceExplanation.zh: 惊讶和被迷住，就像看魔术师表演。🎩

definition.en: So fascinated that you forget about almost everything around you.
definition.zh: 被眼前的事深深吸引，几乎忘了周围的一切。

scenario.en: You watch the magician and hardly blink.
scenario.zh: 你目不转睛地看着魔术师表演。

expression.en: I cannot take my eyes off this!
The magician's tricks are amazing.
expression.zh: 魔术师的表演太神奇了。

expression.en: Can we stay until it is over?

sourceExplanation.en: Very beautiful or impressive, like a big firework show. 🎆
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常美丽或令人印象深刻，就像一场大型烟花表演。🎆

definition.en: Describing something excellent or impressive; not a separate feeling.
definition.zh: 形容事物非常出色或壮观，并不是一种独立的情绪。

scenario.en: You look up at a rainbow stretching across the sky.
scenario.zh: 你抬头望见一道横跨天空的彩虹。

expression.en: What a wonderful sight!
The fireworks light up the sky.
expression.zh: 烟花把夜空照得亮亮的。

expression.en: Shall we watch from here?

sourceExplanation.en: Excited and interested, like learning something new in school. 🏫
sourceExplanation.zh: 兴奋和感兴趣，就像在学校学习新东西。🏫

definition.en: Feeling more alert or interested because something engages your mind or senses.
definition.zh: 新鲜的事物让你精神更活跃、兴趣更浓。

scenario.en: You start asking questions during a lively science experiment.
scenario.zh: 有趣的科学实验开始了，你忍不住连连提问。

expression.en: This has me thinking!
expression.zh: 这件事让我开始动脑筋！

expression.en: That science experiment gave me so many new questions.
expression.zh: 这个科学实验让我冒出好多新问题。

expression.en: Can we try a little experiment?

sourceExplanation.en: Shocked or amazed by something unexpected, like a sudden gift. 🎁
sourceExplanation.zh: 对某些意想不到的事情感到震惊或惊讶，像突然收到礼物。🎁

definition.en: Feeling caught off guard by something unexpected and welcome.
definition.zh: 没想到会发生一件好事，心里又惊又喜。

scenario.en: Your friend gives you a small gift you did not expect.
scenario.zh: 朋友突然送你一份没想到的小礼物。

expression.en: What a lovely surprise!
I had no idea you made this for me.
expression.zh: 我完全不知道你为我准备了这个。

expression.en: How did you keep it a secret?

sourceExplanation.en: Gentle and caring, like petting a small animal. 🐥
sourceExplanation.zh: 温柔和关心，就像抚摸一只小动物。🐥

definition.en: Feeling or showing gentle care and warmth toward someone.
definition.zh: 对别人怀着温柔的关心，说话或动作都轻柔。

scenario.en: You carefully stroke a little kitten that comes to you.
scenario.zh: 一只小猫靠过来，你轻轻地摸摸它。

expression.en: I feel very gentle toward the kitten.
expression.zh: 看到小猫，我心里软软的。

expression.en: I want to pet it carefully.
Is it okay if I touch it?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling grateful for something, like for help you got.🙏
sourceExplanation.zh: 对某事感到感激，就像对你得到的帮助感激。🙏

definition.en: Feeling gratitude for help, kindness or something you value.
definition.zh: 因为得到帮助、善意或珍贵的东西而心怀感谢。

scenario.en: Someone waits for you when you are running late.
scenario.zh: 你来晚了，有人耐心等着你，你心里很感谢。

expression.en: I'm thankful for your help.
You made a hard day easier.
expression.zh: 有你帮忙，今天轻松多了。

expression.en: I want to say thank you.

sourceExplanation.en: Very excited, like going on a fun ride at an amusement park. 🎢
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常兴奋，就像在游乐园里乘坐有趣的游乐设施。🎢

definition.en: Feeling very excited and happy about something special.
definition.zh: 遇到特别期待或刺激的事，心里激动极了。

scenario.en: You fasten your seat belt on a ride you have wanted to try.
scenario.zh: 你坐上一直想体验的游乐设施，兴奋地系好安全带。

expression.en: I am so thrilled!
That roller coaster was exciting.
expression.zh: 刚才坐过山车太刺激了。

expression.en: Can I tell you how it felt?
expression.zh: 我能告诉你是什么感觉吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Emotionally affected, like feeling loved when someone helps you. ❤️
sourceExplanation.zh: 情感上受到影响，就像有人帮助你时感觉被爱。❤️

definition.en: Feeling warmth or gratitude because someone's kindness matters to you.
definition.zh: 因为别人的体贴和善意而深受感动。

scenario.en: A friend saves you a seat when you arrive late.
scenario.zh: 你来晚了，朋友还特地给你留了座位。

expression.en: That was so kind of you.
My friend saved me a seat, and I felt cared for.
expression.zh: 朋友特地给我留了座位，我心里很温暖。

expression.en: Thank you for thinking of me.

sourceExplanation.en: Very quiet and peaceful, like a smooth lake in the morning. 🌊
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常安静和平静，就像早晨的平静湖面。🌊

definition.en: Feeling gently peaceful, with little activity or worry around you.
definition.zh: 周围安静，心里也平静安宁。

scenario.en: You sit beside a still lake as morning light arrives.
scenario.zh: 清晨，你坐在静静的湖边，看着天色渐亮。

expression.en: I feel very calm here.
The lake is smooth in the morning light.
expression.zh: 晨光里的湖面平静极了。

expression.en: Can we sit and listen to the birds?
expression.zh: 我们坐着听听鸟叫好吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling that you can rely on someone, like a best friend. 👫
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉你可以依靠某人，像最好的朋友。👫

definition.en: Feeling able to rely on another person because you expect care and honesty.
definition.zh: 相信一个人可靠、真诚，愿意向对方敞开心扉。

scenario.en: You tell a trusted friend what has been worrying you.
scenario.zh: 你把最近担心的事告诉一位信任的朋友。

expression.en: I know I can trust you.
I felt safe enough to tell my friend what was bothering me.
expression.zh: 我放心地告诉朋友最近烦心的事。

expression.en: May I tell you something important?
expression.zh: 我能告诉你一件重要的事吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Happy and positive, like when you hear your favorite song. 🎵
sourceExplanation.zh: 快乐和积极，就像听到你最喜欢的歌曲时。🎵

definition.en: Feeling cheerful and hopeful, often ready to make the best of things.
definition.zh: 心情开朗又乐观，愿意积极看待眼前的事。

scenario.en: Your favorite song starts playing and you hum along.
scenario.zh: 喜欢的歌响起来，你跟着哼唱。

expression.en: I feel positive today!
My favorite song lifted my mood.
expression.zh: 最喜欢的歌让我心情变好了。

expression.en: Shall we sing together?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling cozy and nice, like cuddling in a blanket. 🧣
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉舒适和惬意，就像在毯子里依偎。🧣

definition.en: Feeling physical warmth or emotional closeness; the two senses are not identical.
definition.zh: 可以指身体暖和，也可以指心里亲近、被关怀；两种意思不同。

scenario.en: You wrap yourself in a blanket beside someone you love.
scenario.zh: 你裹着毯子，坐在喜欢的人身旁。

expression.en: I feel warm and cozy.
This blanket is so soft.
Can we snuggle up and read?
expression.zh: 我们裹着毯子看书好吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Very alert and awake, like in the morning after a good sleep. ☀️
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常警觉和清醒，就像睡了一个好觉后的早晨。☀️

definition.en: Fully awake and alert, not sleepy.
definition.zh: 完全清醒、不困倦，精神很足。

scenario.en: After a restful night, you sit up ready to start the day.
scenario.zh: 睡了一个好觉后，你精神饱满地坐起来。

expression.en: I am wide awake now!
A good sleep left me full of energy.
expression.zh: 睡了个好觉，我精神十足。

expression.en: Are you ready to start the day?
expression.zh: 准备好开始新的一天了吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Really great and enjoyable, like a fantastic trip. 🌟
sourceExplanation.zh: 真的很棒和令人愉快，就像一次奇妙的旅行。🌟

definition.en: Describing someone or something as especially good, not naming a single feeling.
definition.zh: 用来称赞特别好的人或事，不是某一种具体情绪。

scenario.en: You remember a fun family trip and say it was wonderful.
scenario.zh: 你想起一次愉快的家庭旅行，觉得那次旅行真棒。

expression.en: That family trip was wonderful!
I keep smiling when I remember our trip together.
expression.zh: 想起全家一起旅行，我总忍不住笑。

expression.en: Can we come back someday?

sourceExplanation.en: Full of energy and enthusiasm, like when you play a sport you love. ⚽
sourceExplanation.zh: 充满能量和热情，就像玩你喜欢的运动时。⚽

definition.en: Showing a lot of lively energy and enthusiasm for something.
definition.zh: 做喜欢的事时热情洋溢，充满干劲。

scenario.en: You rush onto the field because you cannot wait to play.
scenario.zh: 你迫不及待地跑上球场，准备投入比赛。

expression.en: I feel full of energy and excitement!
I could not wait to run onto the field and play.
expression.zh: 我迫不及待地跑上球场玩起来。

expression.en: Come play a game with me!

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling restless or upset, like when you can't find your favorite toy. 😟
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉不安或烦躁，就像找不到你最喜欢的玩具时。😟

definition.en: Feeling upset and so unsettled that it is hard to stay still or think calmly.
definition.zh: 心里烦乱又不安，很难安静下来或好好思考。

scenario.en: You search everywhere for your favorite toy and start pacing.
scenario.zh: 你到处找心爱的玩具，急得来回走动。

expression.en: I feel restless and upset.
I keep looking for my missing toy.
expression.zh: 我一直找不到最喜欢的玩具。

expression.en: Can you help me look for it?

sourceExplanation.en: Being scared suddenly, like if a loud noise surprises you. 😱
sourceExplanation.zh: 突然感到害怕，比如被大声音吓了一跳。😱

definition.en: Suddenly worried or frightened because something seems dangerous or wrong.
definition.zh: 察觉可能有危险或不对劲，突然紧张害怕起来。

scenario.en: A loud alarm rings while you are walking through school.
scenario.zh: 你走在学校里，突然听到刺耳的警报声。

expression.en: That scared me suddenly!
expression.zh: 刚才我一下子被吓到了！

expression.en: I jumped when I heard the noise.
expression.zh: 听见那声响，我吓得跳起来。

expression.en: Could you stay with me?

sourceExplanation.en: Not wanting to join in, like watching others play but not playing. 😶
sourceExplanation.zh: 不想加入，像是看别人玩但自己不玩。😶

definition.en: Keeping your distance from others, sometimes because you do not want to join in.
definition.zh: 与别人保持距离，暂时不想亲近或参与；这更多是一种态度。

scenario.en: You stay at the edge of a group activity instead of joining.
scenario.zh: 集体活动时，你站在一旁，没有加入。

expression.en: I do not feel like joining in.
expression.zh: 我现在不太想加入大家。

expression.en: I would rather watch the game for now.
expression.zh: 我现在更想先看看他们玩。

expression.en: Can I join later if I feel ready?
expression.zh: 等我想加入的时候再参加好吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling very mad, like when someone breaks your toy. 😡
sourceExplanation.zh: 感到非常生气，就像有人弄坏你的玩具时。😡

definition.en: Feeling strongly upset when something seems unfair, hurtful or wrong.
definition.zh: 遇到不公平、受伤害或不顺心的事，心里生起强烈的不满。

scenario.en: Someone breaks a toy you care about, and you feel angry.
scenario.zh: 有人弄坏了你很珍惜的玩具，你感到生气。

expression.en: I feel angry.
I got upset when my toy was broken.
expression.zh: 玩具被弄坏了，我很生气。

expression.en: I need a little time to calm down.

sourceExplanation.en: Worrying a lot, like when you think about the first day of school. 😬
sourceExplanation.zh: 担心很多，就像你在想上学第一天的情况。😬

definition.en: Feeling uneasy because you keep thinking about something that might go wrong.
definition.zh: 想到将来可能出问题的事，心里一直紧张、不安。

scenario.en: You think about the first day at a new school and wonder what will happen.
scenario.zh: 想到新学校的第一天，你担心会遇到什么。

expression.en: I'm feeling anxious.
I keep thinking about my first school day.
expression.zh: 我总想着开学第一天会怎么样。

expression.en: Can we talk about what worries me?
expression.zh: 我们能聊聊让我担心的事吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Not caring about anything, like feeling nothing matters. 😑
sourceExplanation.zh: 对任何事都不在乎，就像感觉没有什么重要。😑

definition.en: Feeling little interest or motivation about things that would usually matter to you.
definition.zh: 对原本在乎的事也提不起兴趣，暂时没有什么动力。

scenario.en: Your friends suggest a game, but you do not feel like choosing or joining.
scenario.zh: 朋友提议玩游戏，你却没什么兴趣，也不想参与。

expression.en: I do not feel interested right now.
expression.zh: 我现在对什么都提不起兴趣。

expression.en: Even my usual games feel dull today.
expression.zh: 连平时爱玩的游戏今天也没意思。

expression.en: Could we try something different?

sourceExplanation.en: Nervous about something that might happen, like a big test. 📚
sourceExplanation.zh: 对可能发生的事情感到紧张，比如一场大考试。📚

definition.en: Feeling nervous about a possible problem that has not happened yet.
definition.zh: 担心还没发生的事可能不顺利，因此有点紧张。

scenario.en: You wait outside the room before an important test.
scenario.zh: 重要测验开始前，你在教室外紧张地等着。

expression.en: I feel a little uneasy about tomorrow.
I keep thinking about the big test.
expression.zh: 我一直想着那场重要的考试。

expression.en: Can we practice together?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling bad about something you did, like telling a lie. 😳
sourceExplanation.zh: 为自己做过的事情感到难过，比如说了谎。😳

definition.en: Feeling painful embarrassment or regret about something you believe you did wrong.
definition.zh: 觉得自己做错了事，心里难受、羞愧，怕别人知道。

scenario.en: You remember telling a lie and wish you had told the truth.
scenario.zh: 你想起自己说过的谎话，希望当时说了实话。

expression.en: I feel ashamed.
I wish I'd told the truth.
expression.zh: 我真希望刚才说了实话。

expression.en: Can I tell you what happened?
expression.zh: 我能跟你说说发生了什么吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling very tired and worn out, like after a long day of playing. 😩
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉非常疲惫和筋疲力尽，就像玩了一整天后。😩

definition.en: Feeling extremely tired after using a lot of energy.
definition.zh: 活动了很久后累得不行，特别需要休息。

scenario.en: After playing outside all afternoon, you sit down to rest.
scenario.zh: 在外面玩了一下午后，你坐下来休息。

expression.en: I am worn out!
We played outside all afternoon.
expression.zh: 我们在外面玩了一下午。

expression.en: Can we sit down for a while?
expression.zh: 我们能坐下来休息会儿吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Really confused, like when you don't understand the rules of a game. 🤔
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常困惑，比如当你不懂游戏规则时。🤔

definition.en: So confused by something unexpected that you do not know what to think or do.
definition.zh: 事情突然变得难以理解，一时不知道该怎么办。

scenario.en: The rules of a new game change suddenly, and you look around in confusion.
scenario.zh: 新游戏的规则突然改了，你一时不知道怎么继续。

expression.en: I am totally confused!
The rules changed suddenly, and now I do not know what to do.
expression.zh: 规则突然变了，我一下子不知道该怎么办。

expression.en: Could you show me how to play?
expression.zh: 你能示范一下怎么玩吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Upset because of unfair treatment, like not getting a turn. 😞
sourceExplanation.zh: 因不公平的待遇感到不快，比如没有轮到你。😞

definition.en: Holding on to anger or hurt after feeling treated unfairly.
definition.zh: 觉得自己受了不公平的对待，久久放不下委屈和怨气。

scenario.en: You remember being left out of several games and still feel hurt.
scenario.zh: 你想到自己几次被排除在游戏外，心里仍很委屈。

expression.en: I still feel upset about what happened.
expression.zh: 那件事让我一直心里不舒服。

expression.en: I still feel hurt when I remember being left out of those games.
expression.zh: 想起那几次游戏都没带我，我还是很委屈。

expression.en: Could we talk about what happened?
expression.zh: 我们能聊聊刚才的事吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling sad or down, like a rainy day with no friends around. 🌧️
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉悲伤或情绪低落，就像一个没有朋友的雨天。🌧️

definition.en: Feeling a little sad or low; this is an informal use of the word blue.
definition.zh: 心情有点低落、闷闷不乐；这是 blue 的口语用法。

scenario.en: You watch the rain and think about a friend you miss.
scenario.zh: 你看着窗外的雨，想起一位很想念的朋友。

expression.en: I feel a little blue today.
The rain makes me miss my friend even more.
expression.zh: 下雨的时候，我更想念朋友了。

expression.en: Could we play something together indoors?
expression.zh: 我们能在屋里一起玩点什么吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Not interested in anything, like when everything seems dull. 😒
sourceExplanation.zh: 对任何事都不感兴趣，就像一切看起来都很无聊。😒

definition.en: Wanting something interesting to do but not finding anything engaging.
definition.zh: 想找点有趣的事做，却提不起兴趣，觉得无聊。

scenario.en: You have finished your games and cannot find anything new to do.
scenario.zh: 游戏都玩过一遍了，你一时找不到新鲜事。

expression.en: I feel bored.
I can't think of anything fun to do.
expression.zh: 我想不出有什么好玩的事。

expression.en: Can we find something to do together?
expression.zh: 我们能一起找点事做吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling very sad about losing something important, like a best friend. 💔
sourceExplanation.zh: 对失去某个重要的东西感到非常伤心，比如最好的朋友。💔

definition.en: Feeling deep sadness after losing someone or something you care about greatly.
definition.zh: 失去很在乎的人或事时，心里特别难过。

scenario.en: You say goodbye to a dear friend who is moving far away.
scenario.zh: 一位很要好的朋友要搬去很远的地方，你跟对方告别。

expression.en: My heart feels broken.
Saying goodbye to my best friend made me very sad.
expression.zh: 和最要好的朋友告别，我特别难过。

expression.en: Can I talk about how much I miss them?
expression.zh: 我能跟你说说我有多想他们吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling upset because things didn't go as planned. 😖
sourceExplanation.zh: 因事情没有按计划进行而感到沮丧。😖

definition.en: Feeling upset or embarrassed because something you tried did not go as hoped.
definition.zh: 努力做的事没达到预期，觉得懊恼，有时还有点难为情。

scenario.en: Your carefully planned surprise does not work, and you look disappointed.
scenario.zh: 你精心准备的惊喜没成功，心里有点懊恼。

expression.en: I feel upset with myself.
My careful surprise did not work the way I planned.
expression.zh: 精心准备的惊喜没按计划成功，我好懊恼。

expression.en: May I try a different way?

sourceExplanation.en: Not feeling any warmth or emotion, like being distant from others. ❄️
sourceExplanation.zh: 没有感觉到任何温暖或情感，像与他人疏远。❄️

definition.en: Acting emotionally distant or unfriendly; this is different from feeling physically cold.
definition.zh: 态度冷淡，显得不愿亲近；这里不是身体觉得冷。

scenario.en: When someone tries to chat, you give only short replies.
scenario.zh: 有人想和你聊天，你却只简短回答。

expression.en: I feel distant from everyone today.
expression.zh: 今天我不太想和别人亲近。

expression.en: I answered without much warmth.
expression.zh: 我刚才回答得有点冷淡。

expression.en: Can I have some space for a while?
expression.zh: 我能一个人待一会儿吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Worried about something, like when a friend is sick. 😟
sourceExplanation.zh: 对某事感到担忧，比如朋友生病时。😟

definition.en: Feeling worried because someone or something important may not be okay.
definition.zh: 想到在乎的人或事可能出问题，心里感到担心。

scenario.en: You hear that your close friend is sick and wonder if they are okay.
scenario.zh: 听说好朋友生病了，你心里惦记着对方。

expression.en: I am worried about my friend.
They are not feeling well today.
Can we check how they are doing?
expression.zh: 我们能问问他们好些了吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Not sure what is happening or what to do, like when instructions are unclear. 🤷
sourceExplanation.zh: 不确定正在发生什么或该怎么做，比如指示不清楚时。🤷

definition.en: Not understanding something clearly or not knowing what it means.
definition.zh: 看不明白一件事，或不知道该怎么理解。

scenario.en: You read the game instructions twice and still do not understand them.
scenario.zh: 游戏说明读了两遍，你还是没弄懂。

expression.en: I feel confused.
I don't understand these instructions.
Can you explain it one more time?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling angry and annoyed, like when someone keeps bothering you. 😠
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉生气和烦恼，就像有人不停地打扰你时。😠

definition.en: Feeling angry or annoyed, often over a small problem; common in British English.
definition.zh: 有点生气或恼火，常因一件小烦心事；英式英语里常用。

scenario.en: Someone keeps interrupting you while you are trying to play.
scenario.zh: 你正想专心玩，别人却总来打断。

expression.en: I am feeling cross.
Someone kept interrupting my game.
expression.zh: 有人一直打断我玩游戏。

expression.en: Could you let me finish?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling sad and without hope, like after losing a game. 😞
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉悲伤且没有希望，就像输掉一场游戏后。😞

definition.en: Feeling low and discouraged after something disappointing happens.
definition.zh: 遇到失望的事后，心情低落，提不起劲儿。

scenario.en: Your team loses a close game, and you walk away quietly.
scenario.zh: 球队以微弱差距输了比赛，你垂头丧气地走开。

expression.en: I feel really down.
Losing the game left me disappointed.
Can we try again another day?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling very sad and unable to do usual activities, like not wanting to play. 😔
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉非常悲伤且无法进行通常活动，比如不想玩耍。😔

definition.en: A word sometimes used for a long-lasting low mood; depression can also be a health condition.
definition.zh: 有时表示持续的情绪低落，也可能涉及需要专业帮助的抑郁状态。

scenario.en: For many days, activities you once liked have not felt enjoyable.
scenario.zh: 好多天过去了，你发现曾经喜欢的活动也难让自己开心。

expression.en: I have been feeling very low.
expression.zh: 我最近情绪一直很低落。

expression.en: Things I usually enjoy do not feel fun.
expression.zh: 平时喜欢的事情也提不起兴趣。

expression.en: Could I talk with someone I trust?
expression.zh: 我能找信任的人谈谈吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling like there is no hope, like thinking things will never get better. 😞
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉没有希望，就像认为事情永远不会好转。😞

definition.en: Feeling as though a difficult situation may never get better.
definition.zh: 遇到困难时觉得看不到希望，仿佛事情不会好转。

scenario.en: After repeated bad news, you worry there is no way forward.
scenario.zh: 接连听到坏消息后，你一时看不到解决的希望。

expression.en: It feels as if nothing will work.
expression.zh: 我现在觉得怎么做都没用。

expression.en: I have tried so many times.
Can someone help me find a new way?
expression.zh: 有人能帮我想个新办法吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Very sad and without energy, like not wanting to get out of bed. 😔
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常悲伤且没有活力，比如不想起床。😔

definition.en: Feeling deeply discouraged and low, with little energy or hope.
definition.zh: 深深灰心，心情低落，连做事情的劲儿也很少。

scenario.en: After several setbacks, you sit quietly and do not feel ready to try again.
scenario.zh: 接连受挫后，你静静坐着，暂时不想再试。

expression.en: I feel sad and out of energy.
expression.zh: 我很难过，也没什么力气。

expression.en: I do not feel ready to play right now.
Could you sit with me for a bit?

sourceExplanation.en: Not feeling connected to others, like being alone even in a crowd. 🚶‍♂️
sourceExplanation.zh: 没有感觉与他人相连，比如即使在人群中也感到孤独。🚶‍♂️

definition.en: Feeling emotionally far away from what is happening or from other people.
definition.zh: 感觉自己和正在发生的事或周围的人隔着一层距离。

scenario.en: At a busy party, you stand aside and feel little connection to the conversation.
scenario.zh: 热闹的聚会上，你站在一旁，觉得自己融不进去。

expression.en: I feel far away from everyone.
expression.zh: 我觉得自己和大家有些疏远。

expression.en: I am here, but I do not feel connected.
expression.zh: 虽然我在这里，却觉得融不进去。

expression.en: Could we spend some time talking?
expression.zh: 我们能一起聊一会儿吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Disappointed and no longer interested in something, like a hobby you used to love. 🙅
sourceExplanation.zh: 对某事感到失望且不再感兴趣，比如你曾经热爱的爱好。🙅

definition.en: No longer feeling interested or supportive after disappointment or dissatisfaction.
definition.zh: 经历失望或不满后，对原先喜欢的事失去了热情。

scenario.en: A club you loved keeps ignoring your ideas, and you stop wanting to join.
scenario.zh: 喜欢的社团总不理会你的想法，你渐渐不想参加了。

expression.en: I do not enjoy this like I used to.
expression.zh: 这件事不像以前那样让我开心。

expression.en: I used to love this hobby, but not today.
expression.zh: 我以前很喜欢这个爱好，今天却提不起兴趣。

expression.en: Could we try something different?
expression.zh: 我们能试试别的事情吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling let down, like when something you hoped for doesn't happen. 😞
sourceExplanation.zh: 感到失望，就像你所希望的事情没有发生时。😞

definition.en: Feeling sad or let down when something you hoped for does not happen.
definition.zh: 期待的事没有如愿发生，心里有些失落。

scenario.en: You learn that a picnic you had looked forward to is canceled.
scenario.zh: 你期待很久的野餐临时取消了。

expression.en: I feel disappointed.
I was hoping the picnic would happen.
expression.zh: 我本来很期待今天的野餐。

expression.en: Can we make a new plan?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling like giving up, like when something is too hard. 😣
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉想放弃，就像某事太难时。😣

definition.en: Feeling less confident about trying again after a difficult or unsuccessful attempt.
definition.zh: 尝试受挫之后信心变少，有点不想继续。

scenario.en: Your paper airplane keeps falling, and you start to wonder whether to try again.
scenario.zh: 纸飞机试飞了好多次还是落下来，你有点不想再折了。

expression.en: I feel discouraged.
I tried so many times, but it's still hard.
expression.zh: 我试了好多次，还是很难。

expression.en: Could you encourage me to try again?
expression.zh: 你能鼓励我再试一次吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling disappointed about something once liked, like finding out a secret. 😔
sourceExplanation.zh: 对曾经喜欢的东西感到失望，比如发现一个秘密。😔

definition.en: No longer seeing something as wonderful after discovering a disappointing truth.
definition.zh: 知道了令人失望的事实后，对原本喜欢的事不再着迷。

scenario.en: You learn that a trick you loved has an ordinary explanation and feel let down.
scenario.zh: 你知道喜欢的魔术原来有很普通的机关，心里有些失落。

expression.en: It is not as magical as I imagined.
expression.zh: 它不像我想象中那么美好了。

expression.en: Knowing the trick is so ordinary makes it feel less magical.
expression.zh: 知道魔术机关原来很普通，我有点失望。

expression.en: Can we talk about why I feel disappointed?
expression.zh: 我们能聊聊我为什么失望吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Unhappy and annoyed, like when things don't go your way. 😡
sourceExplanation.zh: 不高兴和烦恼，就像事情不按你的方式进行时。😡

definition.en: Feeling unhappy and annoyed because you believe something has not been handled fairly.
definition.zh: 觉得事情安排得不公平，心里不满又恼火。

scenario.en: Your group changes the rules without asking, and you complain.
scenario.zh: 小组没商量就改了规则，你心里很不满。

expression.en: I am not happy about this.
The plan changed without telling me.
expression.zh: 计划变了，却没人告诉我。

expression.en: Could we talk about the change?
expression.zh: 我们能聊聊这个变化吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling strong dislike, like seeing something gross. 🤢
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉强烈的厌恶，比如看到令人恶心的东西。🤢

definition.en: Feeling strong dislike or revulsion toward something unpleasant.
definition.zh: 遇到特别恶心或讨厌的东西，心里强烈排斥。

scenario.en: You smell spoiled food and quickly step back.
scenario.zh: 你闻到变质食物的味道，立刻后退。

expression.en: Yuck, that is disgusting!
The spoiled food smells terrible.
expression.zh: 坏掉的食物闻起来很难闻。

expression.en: Can we move away from it?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling sad and losing hope, like when you keep failing. 😞
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉悲伤且失去希望，就像你不断失败时。😞

definition.en: Losing hope or courage after something difficult or disappointing.
definition.zh: 经历打击或反复受挫后，信心和勇气减弱了。

scenario.en: After your model breaks again, you put the pieces down with a sigh.
scenario.zh: 模型又坏了，你叹了口气，把零件放下。

expression.en: I am losing confidence.
I keep trying, but I have not succeeded yet.
expression.zh: 我一直在试，可还没有成功。

expression.en: Can you help me think of a new idea?
expression.zh: 你能帮我想个新办法吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling shocked and disappointed, like when a plan fails suddenly. 😱
sourceExplanation.zh: 感到震惊和失望，比如当一个计划突然失败时。😱

definition.en: Feeling suddenly worried, upset or discouraged by unwelcome news.
definition.zh: 坏消息突然传来，感到吃惊、担忧或失落。

scenario.en: You hear that your class trip has been canceled at the last minute.
scenario.zh: 临出发前听说班级旅行取消了，你一下子很失落。

expression.en: Oh no, that plan fell apart!
I did not expect our trip to be canceled at the last moment.
expression.zh: 我没想到旅行会在最后一刻取消。

expression.en: Could we make another plan?
expression.zh: 我们能重新想个办法吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Not happy with something, like when a movie is boring. 😒
sourceExplanation.zh: 对某事不满意，比如当一部电影很无聊时。😒

definition.en: Not happy or satisfied with what happened or how something was done.
definition.zh: 对事情的结果或做法不满意，心里有点不高兴。

scenario.en: You find that the movie you expected to love was not enjoyable.
scenario.zh: 你发现期待的电影并没有想象中好看。

expression.en: I am not pleased with this.
I thought the movie would be more fun.
expression.zh: 我以为这部电影会更好看。

expression.en: Could we choose something else next time?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling uneasy and worried, like hearing strange noises at night. 😨
sourceExplanation.zh: 感到不安和担心，比如在夜间听到奇怪的声音。😨

definition.en: Feeling unsettled because something seems uncertain or wrong.
definition.zh: 觉得有什么事不太对劲，心里静不下来。

scenario.en: At night you hear an unfamiliar sound outside the window.
scenario.zh: 夜里你听见窗外传来陌生的声音，心里有点不安。

expression.en: Something is making me uneasy.
I heard a strange noise at night.
expression.zh: 晚上我听见了奇怪的声音。

expression.en: Can you check it with me?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling very upset, like when something bad happens. 😢
sourceExplanation.zh: 感到非常烦恼，就像发生了坏事时。😢

definition.en: Feeling very upset, worried or hurt by something difficult.
definition.zh: 遇到难受或令人担心的事，情绪受到很强的冲击。

scenario.en: You find out that a pet you care for is unwell.
scenario.zh: 你得知自己关心的小宠物生病了，心里很难受。

expression.en: I feel very upset right now.
I am upset because my pet is not feeling well.
expression.zh: 小宠物生病了，我心里特别难受。

expression.en: Can I tell you about it?

sourceExplanation.en: Upset and confused, like when someone interrupts your game. 😠
sourceExplanation.zh: 烦乱和困惑，就像有人打断你的游戏时。😠

definition.en: Feeling upset or unsettled by something troubling, not merely interrupted.
definition.zh: 看到或听到令人不舒服的事，心里受到打扰而不安。

scenario.en: You hear people arguing loudly and find it hard to relax.
scenario.zh: 你听到别人激烈争吵，心里很不舒服。

expression.en: That interruption upset me.
Hearing people argue loudly made me feel unsettled.
expression.zh: 听到别人激烈争吵，我心里很不安。

expression.en: Could you give me a moment to finish?
expression.zh: 你能等我做完这一点吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling sad and without hope, like on a very cloudy day. ☁️
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉悲伤且没有希望，就像在一个非常多云的日子。☁️

definition.en: Looking or feeling sad and disappointed.
definition.zh: 心情低落、失望，脸上也没了笑容。

scenario.en: Your favorite activity is canceled, and you leave with your head down.
scenario.zh: 最喜欢的活动取消了，你低着头离开。

expression.en: I feel down today.
The day did not go as I hoped.
expression.zh: 今天没有像我想的那么顺利。

expression.en: Could we do something gentle together?
expression.zh: 我们能一起做点轻松的事吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling sad and discouraged, like after hearing bad news. 😞
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉悲伤和气馁，就像听到坏消息后。😞

definition.en: Feeling unhappy and less hopeful after a setback or sad news.
definition.zh: 遇到挫折或坏消息后，心情低落，没那么有信心了。

scenario.en: A friend cannot visit as planned, and you feel sad about it.
scenario.zh: 朋友不能按计划来玩，你心里有点低落。

expression.en: My heart feels heavy.
The bad news made me sad.
expression.zh: 那个不好的消息让我难过。

expression.en: Can you listen to me for a while?

sourceExplanation.en: Bored and uninterested, like when a class is not fun. 😐
sourceExplanation.zh: 无聊和不感兴趣，就像上课不有趣时。😐

definition.en: Lacking interest or excitement in a particular activity; it usually describes the activity.
definition.zh: 一件活动缺少趣味或新鲜感，通常是在形容活动本身。

scenario.en: The lesson repeats things you already know, and you start to lose interest.
scenario.zh: 课堂一直重复你已经会的内容，你渐渐没了兴趣。

expression.en: Everything feels a bit boring.
Today has been the same thing over and over.
expression.zh: 今天一直在重复做同样的事。

expression.en: Could we try a new game?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling nervous and tense, like before a performance. 😬
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉紧张和焦虑，就像表演前。😬

definition.en: Feeling tense and easily irritated because you are nervous or uneasy.
definition.zh: 紧张得绷着神经，一点小事也容易烦躁。

scenario.en: Before going onstage, you keep shifting from foot to foot.
scenario.zh: 上台前，你紧张地不停换着脚站。

expression.en: I am on edge.
I am waiting for my turn to perform.
Can I take a deep breath first?

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling awkward and shy, like when you make a mistake in front of others. 😳
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉尴尬和害羞，就像在别人面前犯错误时。😳

definition.en: Feeling awkward or self-conscious after a mistake or unwanted attention.
definition.zh: 出错或被人注意到时，感到难为情、不自在。

scenario.en: You say the wrong answer aloud and notice everyone looking.
scenario.zh: 你大声说错了答案，发现大家都在看你。

expression.en: I feel embarrassed.
Everyone saw me make that mistake.
Please give me a moment.

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling angry because of unfair treatment, like being blamed unfairly. 😠
sourceExplanation.zh: 因不公平的待遇感到愤怒，比如被不公正地责备。😠

definition.en: Feeling lasting anger or hurt after believing life has treated you unfairly.
definition.zh: 觉得长期受了委屈，心里积起难以消散的怨气。

scenario.en: After being unfairly blamed many times, you find it hard to trust the group.
scenario.zh: 被不公平地责怪了好几次后，你很难再信任那个小组。

expression.en: I still feel hurt and angry.
Being blamed unfairly really upset me.
Can we talk about what is fair?
expression.zh: 我们能聊聊什么才公平吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Very frustrated and annoyed, like when something keeps going wrong. 😖
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常沮丧和烦恼，就像某事持续出错时。😖

definition.en: Feeling extremely annoyed because the same problem keeps happening.
definition.zh: 同样的麻烦一再发生，烦得快受不了了。

scenario.en: The zipper gets stuck yet again when you are trying to leave.
scenario.zh: 你正要出门，拉链却又卡住了，真让人恼火。

expression.en: I am getting so frustrated!
I have tried again and again.
expression.zh: 我已经反复试了好多次。

expression.en: Can you help me take a short break?

sourceExplanation.en: Very tired, like after a long day of work or play. 😴
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常疲倦，就像经过一整天的工作或玩耍后。😴

definition.en: Feeling so tired that you have very little energy left.
definition.zh: 累得几乎没有力气了，很需要休息。

scenario.en: After a long hike, you sit down and drink water.
scenario.zh: 走了很长一段山路后，你坐下来喝水。

expression.en: I am completely exhausted.
Today was full of running and playing.
Can I rest before we go on?
expression.zh: 我们继续前，我能先休息吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling tired and weak, like needing a rest after a long walk. 😓
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉疲倦和虚弱，就像长时间步行后需要休息。😓

definition.en: Feeling physically or mentally tired, sometimes for a longer time.
definition.zh: 身体或精神感到疲乏，有时持续得比较久。

scenario.en: After a long day of concentrating, you find it hard to keep reading.
scenario.zh: 专心学习了很长时间，你已经很难继续看书了。

expression.en: I feel worn out.
That long walk used up my energy.
expression.zh: 刚才走了很远，我没力气了。

expression.en: Could we walk more slowly?

sourceExplanation.en: Scared of something, like being afraid of the dark. 😨
sourceExplanation.zh: 对某事感到害怕，比如害怕黑暗。😨

definition.en: Feeling afraid because something seems dangerous or uncertain.
definition.zh: 觉得可能有危险或发生不好的事，心里害怕。

scenario.en: You look down a dark hallway and hesitate to enter.
scenario.zh: 你看着黑暗的走廊，犹豫着要不要进去。

expression.en: I feel afraid.
It's dark and I can't see well.
Can you hold my hand?

sourceExplanation.en: Unable to sit still, like when you're nervous or excited. 😬
sourceExplanation.zh: 无法静坐，就像你紧张或兴奋时。😬

definition.en: Having trouble staying still, sometimes because of excitement or nerves.
definition.zh: 坐不住、总想动来动去，有时因为紧张或兴奋。

scenario.en: You keep moving your feet while waiting for your turn.
scenario.zh: 等着轮到自己时，你的脚一直动个不停。

expression.en: I cannot sit still!
My legs keep wanting to move.
Can I stand up for a minute?
expression.zh: 我能站起来活动一会儿吗？

sourceExplanation.en: Feeling alone and sad, like when you have no one to play with. 😢
sourceExplanation.zh: 感觉孤单和悲伤，就像没有人和你玩时。😢

definition.en: Feeling lonely, sad and somewhat without hope.
definition.zh: 又孤单又难过，心里有点无依无靠。

scenario.en: You sit by yourself while all the other children have found a partner.
scenario.zh: 别的孩子都找到了搭档，你却独自坐在一边。

expression.en: I feel very lonely.
I have no one to play with right now.
Could you stay with me?

sourceExplanation.en: Very scared, like when you see something scary. 😱
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常害怕，就像看到令人害怕的东西时。😱

definition.en: Feeling scared because something sudden or threatening happened.
definition.zh: 遇到突发或可能危险的事，心里害怕起来。

scenario.en: A sudden crash nearby makes you jump and look around.
scenario.zh: 旁边突然一声巨响，你吓得一跳，四处张望。

expression.en: I was frightened.
That sound scared me!
expression.zh: 刚才那个声音吓了我一跳！

expression.en: Can you stay close to me?

sourceExplanation.en: Very angry, like when someone ruins something important to you. 😡
sourceExplanation.zh: 非常生气，就像有人破坏对你很重要的东西时。😡

definition.en: Feeling extremely angry, often because something feels very unfair or hurtful.
definition.zh: 因为严重的不公平或伤害而非常生气，怒气很强烈。

scenario.en: Someone deliberately ruins a project you worked hard to build.
scenario.zh: 有人故意毁掉你辛苦做好的作品，你气坏了。

expression.en: I am extremely angry!
